items.title: William Ballariel Interview, 1959-10-02
items.q: There's only three of us that played in the late year, a good while back. That's Johnny Pope, myself, and a fellow named Denny Trainor.

ctx.x: I noticed in a book, Mr. Malero, that it starts off again in 1939. Did you leave the band for a while?

Yeah, I left the band for a while. I left the band for a while. They made me a band for some instance, and I quit for a while, but they insisted on me coming back and I went back, you see. I wondered too about in the... I stayed in it until I just got tired and went down, going down, so I just stayed in it. So practice going down and on. There's only three of us that played in the late year, a good while back. That's Johnny Pope, myself, and a fellow named Denny Trainor. I think his name's right, his name's…
Did you always have the music for all of the pieces or did sometimes you make it up with your head and your head?
